001: Yes, I'm looking for a coat for the winter.
We have this model in black and in navy blue.
I really like the navy blue. Can I try it on?
Of course, the fitting room is at the back on the right.
Perfect, thank you. I'll go there right away.
002: Did you find what you were looking for?
Yes, but I'm not sure about the size.
This one is a size up. Do you want to compare?
Good idea. I'll try both to see.
Take your time. I'll take care of the other customers.
Thanks, that's kind. I'll call you if I need anything.
003: Is this bag made of genuine leather?
Yes, it's very high quality leather.
And is it made in France?
No, it's made in Italy, but the finish is excellent.
I see. And how long is it guaranteed for?
It's guaranteed for two years against any manufacturing defect.
004: I'm torn between these two dresses. Which one do you think is better?
Honestly, the red one suits your complexion better.
You think so? I thought it was a bit too flashy.
Not at all, it's elegant. And it's very well cut.
It's true that it's pretty. I might take it.
Good choice. It'll be perfect for the evening.
005: Excuse me, I'd like some information about this watch.
Of course. It's an automatic model, water-resistant up to one hundred meters.
And it works without a battery?
Exactly, it winds itself thanks to the movements of the wrist.
That's very convenient. And what's its price?
It's three hundred and fifty euros. It's on sale this week.
006: Did you see those shoes? They're gorgeous.
Yes, but they look really uncomfortable.
Really? I thought they looked comfortable.
Look at the height of the heel. You'll be suffering after an hour.
You might be right. I'll look for a more reasonable pair.
Good idea. Let's look at the styles with lower heels.
007: Can I pay by bank card?
Yes, of course. The machine is right here.
Perfect. And can I get a receipt?
Yes, I'll print you a receipt with the details of the purchases.
Thank you very much. And do you accept gift vouchers?
Sorry, we don't accept gift vouchers, only cards and cash.
008: I bought this sweater yesterday, but it's too small.
I understand. Do you have the receipt?
Yes, here it is. I'd like to exchange it for a size up.
Let me check if we have size forty-two in stock.
Okay, I'll wait. I hope you have it.
Good news, we have the same model in forty-two. I'll get it ready for you.
009: This vase is very original. Where does it come from?
It's handmade by an artisan from Provence.
Ah, that's why it has that unique style.
Yes, each piece is slightly different, that's its charm.
I find it really beautiful. I'll take it for my mother.
Excellent idea. I'll wrap it up carefully for you.
010: Did you see the price of this jacket? It's crazy!
Yes, but it's a big brand. The quality is there.
I'd rather buy a cheaper and more original model.
You're right, there are very nice things in the shop next door.
Should we take a look? We might find a good deal.
Let's go. You never know, we might be surprised.
